All right! I gotta get back into the swing
of things!

From here on, I think only about the
next race! I'll
work harder than ever to
win it!

text_block_list.text: You're upset too... I see—it isn't just me.

text_block_list.text:

forward?!

text_block_list.text:
I'll hold on tight to this feeling! And
then...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I have—full power
for total
victory! And then we'll both
smile and laugh!
Woooo!

text_block_list.text:

you feel
this way again!
